title: Grof's book: discarnate aliens would show up as hallucinations

tellings.quote: Grath actually in one of his books he said look if if there are advanced intelligent beings you know aliens that are kind of non-physical discarnate

plain: If advanced beings exist that have no physical body, they might reach us in a form that looks like hallucination, according to an argument in one of the books of an author named Stanislav Grof (the transcript renders the name 'Grath'). The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore brings this up on Michels's show in 2025, citing the book without naming it. If true, some visions might be real contact rather than tricks of the brain.
